extras_2_runs.interpretation: Runs taken off a no-ball that did not come off the bat (bye/leg-bye off a no-ball): always on no-ball families and only when runs==0. Counted in team runs; not charged to the bowler (Law 18/22 accounting: byes/leg-byes off no-balls are scored as no-ball extras for the team but only the 1-run penalty is debited to the bowler).
